name: Cirebon

queries.query: Peta bidang tanah Kota Cirebon Kantor Pertanahan WFS GeoServer Satu Peta resmi
queries.scope: Confirm a first-party local cadastral source and test its public parcel geometry service.
queries.result: The official Kota Cirebon Satu Peta portal lists public parcel-boundary datasets for all five kecamatan, owned by Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon and revised in 2025. The public API exposes WFS download URLs and the layer schemas expose a full MultiPolygon geometry field. Three geometry-only records were returned from the Kejaksan city-core layer. A small query at the WUP point returned no feature in any of the six listed parcel mapsets; the published City of Cirebon extent starts about 122 m east of the WUP longitude.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Indonesian-language search; read-only public API catalog, layer metadata, WFS schema, small resultType=hits BBOX requests and a three-feature geometry-only WFS query.

queries.query: Cirebon city official public cadastral parcel map GeoServer WFS land office
queries.scope: Cross-check that the catalog layers are cadastral parcels and locally operated rather than a general land-use map.
queries.result: Official city pages describe Satu Peta as a public integrated geospatial portal. Its approved datasets identify Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon as the owner and describe parcel boundaries, shape, area and position. Geometry was confirmed in a separate city-core window, not at the ranked WUP point.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search followed by first-party municipal catalog and read-only WFS inspection.

portals.name: Satu Peta Kota Cirebon
portals.operator: Pemerintah Kota Cirebon; public city geospatial portal
portals.observation: The city catalog lists six active/approved parcel datasets, including five kecamatan layers and a separate Kesambi kelurahan layer. The dataset records name Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon as owner, revision year 2025, public classification, Polygon mapset type and GeoServer WMS/WFS services.

portals.name: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon parcel layers
portals.operator: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon (local land office, ATR/BPN)
portals.observation: Public WFS layers include bpn:Persil_Kec_Kejaksan, bpn:Persil_Kec_Kesambi, bpn:Persil_Kec_Lemahwungkuk, bpn:Persil_Kec_Pekalipan and bpn:Persil_Kec_Harjamukti. The inspected schema exposes geom as MultiPolygon plus descriptive parcel attributes. Only geom was requested; sample properties were omitted.

portals.name: Official City of Cirebon boundary metadata
portals.operator: Indonesian National Geospatial Information Network / City of Cirebon metadata record
portals.observation: The published bounding envelope begins at longitude 108.518230847; ranked WUP longitude is 108.517123333245, about 122 m west. This is an extent check, not a replacement parcel or boundary geometry.

requests.observation: Anonymous catalog count endpoint returned 66 mapsets.
Returned 66 mapsets. Parcel mapsets list public WFS SHAPE-ZIP endpoints and public WMS preview services; five district parcel layers cover the five city kecamatan.
Schema identifies geom as a gml:MultiPolygonPropertyType. Other attributes include administrative and parcel identifiers; none were requested in the sample.
A 100 m by 100 m projected city-core query matched 12 features and returned zero records in hits mode.
WFS returned three full MultiPolygon features, totalFeatures=12, numberReturned=3. Query requested only geom; sanitized repo sample retains only anonymous GeoServer feature IDs and geometry.
Temporary geometry-only page-offset probe returned one feature at startIndex=3; its feature ID differed from all three saved IDs.

The WUP-point neighborhood query returned numberMatched=0 and numberReturned=0. Equivalent small projected windows returned zero across the five city district layers and the separate Kesambi kelurahan layer.

freshResearch.executionMethod: Official Indonesian and English sources, public Satu Peta metadata and anonymous WFS GET requests; geometry-only sample; no account, parcel ID, owner or address query.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: Three full geometries remain verified from a bounded Kejaksan city-core window about 4.88 km from the WUP centroid. The local WFS DescribeFeatureType marks its native nib field optional; the existing WFS adapter could page a dense cell, but qualification failed because some features lack nib and distinct geometries conflict under repeated nib values. Exact native-ID retrieval is not reliable, so no runtime adapter is qualified. The WUP point being outside the municipal extent is retained as context, not used as the adapter gate.

source.name: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon parcel layers via Satu Peta
source.operator: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon / Pemerintah Kota Cirebon
source.serviceType: Public OGC WFS and WMS; catalog also advertises SHAPE-ZIP
source.nativeIdField: nib (published optional string, observed null/missing and non-unique for distinct geometries); GeoServer transport feature IDs are separately present but are not a WFS schema attribute supported by the existing adapter’s queryIds contract.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Five publicly listed and approved district parcel mapsets cover the five administrative kecamatan of Kota Cirebon; each is attributed in the city catalog to the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon and revision year 2025.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three full geometry-only parcels retrieved from a bounded Kejaksan city-core window. The local land-office source and full polygons are verified. The existing adapter paged dense windows but failed on missing and conflicting native nib values during its 13-cell qualification; exact-ID behavior is not qualified. WUP neighborhood hit counts were zero, but this point mismatch is not the adapter gate.

registryBasis: First-party Kota Cirebon Satu Peta catalog lists approved, public parcel-boundary datasets owned by the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Cirebon. The exposed WFS returns full MultiPolygon geometry in the city core.
technicalBlocker: The existing WFS adapter requires a stable unique native attribute for queryIds. The public schema marks nib optional; bounded 13-cell queries exposed missing native IDs and the adapter rejected conflicting geometry under repeated nib values during fresh-ID reads. GeoServer transport FIDs are present, but the existing adapter does not use them as durable parcel IDs.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the publisher can expose a complete, stable unique cadastral key (or whether a separately reviewed adapter should use GeoServer FIDs); coverage and completeness outside the bounded Kejaksan sample window remain unverified.
nextStep: Keep the source and three verified city-core polygons as research evidence. Do not enable runtime with the current adapter. Root can decide whether a source-specific FID adapter is appropriate after reviewing the recorded WFS contract and acceptance evidence.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
